method: Fetched each page signed-out, extracted every <script src>, fetched each script, matched credential SHAPES. Matched values are never recorded — only the shape name and a count.

assets.false_positive_reason: The literal text DATABASE_URL appears only inside a source-code comment explaining what happens when the variable is set on Netlify. It is the variable's NAME, never a value. Verified by reading the surrounding characters in the live file.

supabase_note.explanation: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is public by design and would NOT be a finding. SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY / service_role must never appear.
supabase_note.finding: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY does not appear in any page script either. Its absence is not a problem — it is public by design and would have been fine. SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY and service_role do not appear anywhere. That is the part that matters.
